text:
Perfect! Let me help you modify the watch in Order #W9810810 from white dial to black dial while keeping the leather strap.

First, I need to check what watch options are available to make sure we can get the exact combination you want.
zh:
太好了！让我帮你修改订单#W9810810里的手表，从白色表盘换成黑色表盘，同时保留皮带。

首先，我需要确认有哪些手表选项可用，以确保我们能得到你想要的精确组合。
